creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-13: "drag tab ordering in side panel".

Pane rows can be dragged: onto a row in the same tab to trade places, onto another tab's row to move there. A tab's caption row cannot be dragged. Tab order belongs to the window's composition (`docs/architecture.md`, "The order of tabs is the window's"), so a reorder is the window's to apply, not a daemon request.

No verb reorders tabs either: `muster tab move` hands a tab to another window. A verb that places a tab before or after another would give the drag an intent on the one action path, and would fix a_2hIfvJdL0, a tab that jumps to first place with no way to move it back.
title: Drag a tab in the sidebar to reorder tabs
